# Inner Bloom Psychiatry

> Marie Newball, PMHNP-BC provides telehealth-only psychiatric evaluations and
> medication management for patients in Texas. Visits are available in English
> and Spanish, Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central Time.

## Practice facts

- Practice name: Inner Bloom Psychiatry
- Provider: Marie Newball, PMHNP-BC (Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner, board certified)
- NPI: 1346718053
- Modality: Telehealth only, via Zoom — no in-person office
- Service area: Texas
- Ages treated: children under 12, adolescents 12–17, adults 18–64, older adults 65+
- Focus areas: trauma & PTSD, anxiety, depression, ADHD, behavioral health concerns
- Services: psychiatric evaluations, medication management, virtual psychiatric care
- Does not provide talk therapy (patients often pair care with a separate therapist)
- Insurance: accepted via Headway — Aetna, Ascension (SmartHealth), Blue Cross Blue Shield
  of Texas (HMO & PPO), Carelon Behavioral Health, Cigna, Oscar (Optum), Oxford (Optum),
  Quest Behavioral Health, United Healthcare (Optum)
- Self-pay pricing: $100 initial evaluation, $75/month follow-up
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Contact: info@theinnerbloompsychiatry.com, 832-947-4208
- Emergencies: this practice cannot handle crisis care — call or text 988, or call 911
